title: ABC Monster Book
description: A personalized first alphabet book with one bold letter and one playful scene starring the child's monster on every page.

pages.text: ABC Monster Book
pages.illustrationPrompt: Simple half-title page with a few colorful alphabet blocks and generous negative space.
Bright title page with the personalized monster surrounded by a loose arc of large, colorful letters. Preserve clear space for the title.

pages.text: This book belongs to {child_name}, who imagined the one-and-only {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Dedication and copyright page featuring a framed miniature of the child's original monster drawing and a restrained alphabet-block border.

pages.text: Come learn the ABCs with {monster_name}!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Welcoming opening scene with the personalized monster beside a large open alphabet book. Do not assume specific anatomy, clothing, or abilities.

pages.text:
A is for APPLE.
A shiny apple for {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature an enormous uppercase A, a lowercase a, and one shiny red apple beside the personalized monster. Clean background and strong object recognition.

pages.text:
B is for BUBBLES.
Big bubbles, baby bubbles, bubbles everywhere!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase B, lowercase b, and translucent bubbles floating around the personalized monster. Keep the face and silhouette unobscured.

pages.text:
C is for CAKE.
{monster_name} has a colorful cake to share.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase C, lowercase c, and a cheerful layered cake on a table beside the personalized monster. No birthday-specific wording.

pages.text:
D is for DANCE.
Dance to the beat, {monster_name}!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase D and lowercase d in a lively music scene. Convey dancing through rhythm, pose, and floating music notes without assuming legs.

pages.text:
E is for ELEPHANT.
A gentle elephant says hello.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase E, lowercase e, a friendly elephant, and the personalized monster greeting one another in an open grassy setting.

pages.text:
F is for FLOWERS.
{monster_name} finds flowers in every color.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase F, lowercase f, and a simple garden filled with clearly shaped flowers. Place the personalized monster in a flexible clear zone.

pages.text:
G is for GIGGLE.
What makes {monster_name} giggle?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase G and lowercase g with a playful, joyful scene. Express laughter through atmosphere and typography without changing the monster's approved features.

pages.text:
H is for HAT.
A huge hat for a happy day.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase H, lowercase h, and an oversized whimsical hat near the personalized monster. Do not place it on the monster unless the approved design supports it.

pages.text:
I is for ICE CREAM.
One chilly scoop for {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase I, lowercase i, and a single colorful ice-cream cone on a stand beside the personalized monster.

pages.text:
J is for JELLYBEANS.
Jolly jellybeans fill the jar.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase J, lowercase j, and a clear jar of bright jellybeans. Keep the composition uncluttered and the letter dominant.

pages.text:
K is for KITE.
Up, up, up goes {monster_name}'s kite.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase K, lowercase k, and a diamond-shaped kite in a blue sky. Stage the kite near the monster without requiring hands.

pages.text:
L is for LIBRARY.
{monster_name} loves choosing a book.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase L, lowercase l, and a cozy children's library with a few large book shapes. Keep the scene readable rather than shelf-heavy.

pages.text:
M is for MOON.
The moon glows above {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase M, lowercase m, and a warm crescent moon in the sky above the personalized monster. The moon stays in the sky, never on or inside the monster.

pages.text:
N is for NEST.
A little nest rests in the tree.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase N, lowercase n, and a small empty nest safely resting on a low branch while the personalized monster looks on.

pages.text:
O is for OCEAN.
{monster_name} watches the waves roll in.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase O, lowercase o, and a calm ocean with rounded waves. Keep the personalized monster safely on the sandy shore.

pages.text:
P is for PAINT.
Purple, pink, and plenty of paint!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase P, lowercase p, paint pots, and broad colorful marks on paper. Avoid showing anatomy-dependent painting actions.

pages.text:
Q is for QUIET.
Shhh... {monster_name} found a quiet place.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase Q and lowercase q in a calm reading nook with soft cushions and gentle light.

pages.text:
R is for RAINBOW.
Every color arches across the sky.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase R, lowercase r, a bold rainbow, and the personalized monster in a simple open landscape.

pages.text:
S is for STARS.
{monster_name} counts the sparkling stars.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase S, lowercase s, and a small number of large, readable stars in a deep blue sky.

pages.text:
T is for TRAIN.
Chug, chug! The little train rolls by.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase T, lowercase t, and a friendly toy-like train passing the personalized monster. No recognizable branded train characters.

pages.text:
U is for UMBRELLA.
An umbrella keeps {monster_name} cozy and dry.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase U, lowercase u, a large umbrella sheltering the personalized monster, and soft rounded raindrops.

pages.text:
V is for VEGETABLES.
Crunchy carrots and green peas for {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase V, lowercase v, a few clearly recognizable vegetables, and the personalized monster at a simple market stand.

pages.text:
W is for WAGON.
A wonderful red wagon waits for {monster_name}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase W, lowercase w, and a classic red wagon beside the personalized monster. Do not place the monster inside unless scale safely allows it.

pages.text:
X is for XYLOPHONE.
Ding, dong, ding goes the xylophone.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase X, lowercase x, and a rainbow-colored toy xylophone. Suggest sound with small graphic notes.

pages.text:
Y is for YELLOW.
A bright yellow sun warms the day.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase Y, lowercase y, and a sunny yellow scene with the personalized monster. Use yellow boldly without overwhelming letter readability.

pages.text:
Z is for ZZZ.
After a busy alphabet, {monster_name} is ready to rest.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Feature uppercase Z, lowercase z, and a cozy resting scene. Do not assume the monster uses a bed or closes eyes; convey calm through lighting and surroundings.

pages.text: A, B, C... which letter do you love best?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Alphabet review page showing A through Z once, in correct order, large and highly legible. Add a small personalized monster without competing with the letters.

pages.text:
{child_name} made {monster_name}.
Together, they made learning the alphabet an adventure.

The end.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Warm closing page featuring the child's original drawing beside the transformed personalized monster, with a few favorite objects from earlier pages.
